MAIN.TITLE: SwimResults
MAIN.SUBTITLE: Your Platform for Swim Results & Swimming Competition Data
MAIN.INTRO_INFO_TEXT: SwimResults is your platform for swim results and swimming competition data. We provide comprehensive swim results and meet information for participating events displayed in a structured manner. SwimResults enables swimmers, coaches, friends and family to view swim results, start lists, live timings and detailed analysis for different athletes, teams and competitions.

INFOS.FEATURES_INFO_TEXT: Live timings, placements, start lists, interactive schedules and file collections: SwimResults provides lots of features and contents.
INFOS.BLOG_INFO_TEXT: Our developer and user blog informs you about upcoming features, gives tips on how to use SwimResults and provides answers to frequently asked questions.
INFOS.ORGANIZER_INFO_TEXT: You are organising a swimming competition and want to provide SwimResults support for your participants?
INFOS.SERVICE_INFO_TEXT: Result services can have a cooperation with SwimResults to offer online services to their customers.

FEATURES.STARTS_INFO_TEXT: Start lists, lane assignments and starting times for each athlete with all important information at a glance: the entry list to explore
FEATURES.RESULTS_TITLE: The long walk to the results board
FEATURES.RESULTS_INFO_TEXT: As soon as you finish, your provisional time is in the system, immediately after the results are released, placements and final times are visible. Never photograph results again!
FEATURES.SEARCH_INFO_TEXT: With the search function, athletes and clubs can be found in a flash and their starts or members can be viewed.
FEATURES.LIVETIMING_TITLE: Oops! Missed the race in livetiming
FEATURES.LIVETIMING_INFO_TEXT: Those watching from home know the problem: Blink and miss the livetiming. The livetiming in SwimResults has features to 'rewind' and pause.
FEATURES.FILES_INFO_TEXT: Entry list, results, DSV file or order form: All files current and sorted in one place.
FEATURES.FAVS_INFO_TEXT: Choose which athlete you are and who your favorites are to get customized overviews and notifications.

SRM.INTRO_INFO_TEXT: The SwimResults Manager (SRM) allows organizers and result services to independently manage SwimResults data. In particular, livetiming can be implemented via the SRM.
SRM.LIVE_TIMING_OMEGA_INFO_TEXT: Both OMEGA Ares and Quantum can be connected to the SRM via the data handling interface. The program then automatically transmits the live times to the internet.
SRM.LIVE_TIMING_ALGE_INFO_TEXT: Livetiming with ALGE timing systems can also be implemented with the SRM. For this, the SRM computer must be on the same network to receive the UDP packets from the ALGE system.
SRM.SCHEDULE_INFO_TEXT: The SRM offers the ability to create schedules and events such as "Warm-up", "Team Leader" and "Referee Meeting" to inform participants and spectators about the schedule of the event.
SRM.IMPORT_INFO_TEXT: Data from entry results and results sheets can be imported into the SwimResults system using the import function. This allows newly set races or corrected times to be made available quickly.
SRM.AUTO_IMPORT_INFO_TEXT: In particular, regular importing of result sheets can be automated with the auto-import function. As soon as a new result sheet is placed in a specific folder, it is automatically imported into the system and the data is updated.
